Definition: burning, i.e. a carbuncle or other fiery gem
BiblicalUsage: ʼEqdâch means a carbuncle — a burning, fiery gem. It occurs just once, where God promises to make Jerusalem's windows of agates and her gates of carbuncles. The word is fire made into stone.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe ʼeqdâch is a word for the city God builds: burning stones and bright gates, and a glory no enemy can dim.
